messages.subject: segfault in Shiny but not in interactive mode
parts:
I'm getting this nasty segfault error (below) and sometimes I also get an error that says:

Error in `/usr/lib64/R/bin/exec/R': double free or corruption (!prev): 0x00000000077dc1a0 ***

I'd try reinstalling plyr, as that's where the crash is happening.

If this is reliably reproducible with an updated plyr, then it might be easiest to put a browser() call right before the ddply call, and examine the input--I suspect you'll find it's a different shape than expected.

messages.subject: Re: segfault in Shiny but not in interactive mode
parts: Thanks Joe, I reproduced the problem even after re-installing plyr. I ended up completely removing all dependencies on ddply and used aggregate instead and works fine now. It's actually quite a bit faster too.

On Monday, March 16, 2015 at 12:23:53 PM UTC-4, Joe Cheng [RStudio] wrote:
I'd try reinstalling plyr, as that's where the crash is happening.

If this is reliably reproducible with an updated plyr, then it might be easiest to put a browser() call right before the ddply call, and examine the input--I suspect you'll find it's a different shape than expected.

On Mon, Mar 16, 2015 at 8:31 AM, tcash21 <tany...@gmail.com> wrote:
